name: Path Sum
description: Checks if there exists a root-to-leaf path in a binary tree whose values sum to the given target.
aim: DFS from root to leaves, tracking running sum. At each leaf, check if sum equals target.
howItWorks: Subtract current node value from target
If leaf node and remaining target=0: path found!
Recursively check left and right subtrees
Return true if any path found

time.bestCase: Root is leaf with matching value

alternatives: BFS with running sum — iterative approach
